description: Air65 II standard Racing frame: four thin-wall upper ducts, sixteen bowed rectangular ribs, four hollow triangular motor pads, cardinal mounting bosses, and integrated two-loop battery cage.

provenance.feature: Nominal frame envelope, 65mm diagonal motor spacing, 33mm duct bores and 3.8mm continuous upper band
provenance.note: Published manufacturer nominals; dimensional tolerance is unknown. Locations and derived duct lip radius follow the frozen architecture.

provenance.feature: Motor pad bores and four cardinal mounting holes
provenance.note: Center4mm,three1.4mm bores on6.6mm PCD. Frame screw axes use25.5mm square pitch with1.2mm pilots. Pad rotations FL/RL+30deg,FR/RR-30deg relative to +Y-first shared triangle.

provenance.feature: Motor rib plan locations and open connecting topology
provenance.note: FL lip crossings traced at(319,151),(177,225),(472,361),(264,473) around motor center(318,319) in1080px image; mirrored on X/Y. Endpoint angles89.66,146.31,-15.26,-109.32deg. Quarter-ellipse rib Z curvature is inferred from side drawing, not measured.

provenance.feature: Duct cross-section, pad thickness, ribs, mounting dishes and guards
provenance.note: Shared registry supplies main thicknesses and Z levels. Submillimetre transition offsets0.02..0.58mm,0.42mm top motor locators, and short guard arcs are cosmetic estimates within the nominal frame envelope.

Review v2 replaces overlapping annuli/webs with one explicit watertight plate per motor, containing central4mm and three1.4mm through bores. Rounded triangle is a tangent convex contour around the three screw lobes. Cap area and manifold edge incidence were checked; no duplicate coplanar surfaces remain within a pad.

Two true11.4x6.2mm XZ openings. Shared loop centers remain+/-7.2mm; entire hoops now slope fore/aft to separate upper/lower bands in plan and recover narrow reference windows. Shear2.1mm at outer top/bottom extremes and0.45mm inner fillet are image-derived estimates; XZ battery clearance is unchanged.

The contract permits one scalar reference plus scale/offset. Mesh screw-hole vertices directly reference their bore diameter with center offsets derived from frozen PCD6.6mm. Outer contours are normalized against motor_pad_outer_radius. Regenerating the JSON from registry is required after changing PCD; current hole centers, diameters and constraints are exact.

Removed coincident motor-pad cap surfaces and marker/bridge cap overlaps by replacing each group with a single explicitly triangulated closed mesh. Frame material was unchanged. Sloped cradle geometry restores two narrow projected windows; this is an estimated reconstruction rather than a new verified measurement.
